description: Optional inspiration palette of research strategies. NOT consulted by runtime routing.

strategies.name: Discriminating-prediction-first
strategies.description: Identify the prediction the hypothesis makes that no competitor makes; design the cheapest test of that prediction.

strategies.name: Confound-control-first
strategies.description: Identify the dominant confound; design controls before designing the manipulation.

strategies.name: Replication-budget-first
strategies.description: Plan replications proportional to base-rate novelty; novel findings need more replications than confirmatory ones.

strategies.name: Pre-registration-first
strategies.description: Specify predictions, sample size, and analysis plan before data collection. Strongest defense against post-hoc rationalization.

strategies.name: Evidence-tier-aware
strategies.description: Weight existing citations by tier (systematic-review > RCT > cohort > observational > expert > anecdote); avoid overweighting low-tier sources.

strategies.name: Minimum-viable experiment
strategies.description: Design the cheapest experiment that would yield interpretable evidence, even if underpowered for full effect size. Triage step before expensive design.
